groups.name: Shaft
groups.sources: Chain flexible shaft is a research model (#12686, #12691); flex and stiffness flags arrive with #15150 Track C1. Shaft options are set when the bundle is built.

groups.name: Inputs
groups.sources: Same-input bundle and receipt inputs used by every published clip set (NV-5, #11678).

groups.name: Force Overlay
groups.limitations: Forces on a kinematic replay (all-zero efforts) are not available: vectors are hidden, and palm-thumb, grip JSON and strips are not yet gated (#15150 G1).
groups.sources: Torques are the bundle's recorded tracking efforts, ground forces come from the contact model and grip forces are solved, none measured (#15150 parity review).

groups.name: Ellipsoids
groups.limitations: Capacity ellipsoids fall back to mobility radii without torque limits (#15150 G2); the drift arrow is not drawn (G3).

groups.name: Segment Shading
groups.sources: Inverse-dynamics axial load with unfiltered accelerations; OpenSim is unshaded (#15150 parity review).

groups.name: Impact Factors
groups.sources: Kinematic impact conditions from club forward kinematics (#15150).

groups.name: Ball Flight
groups.sources: Flight in the video is a model prediction; experimental while #15443 is open.

groups.name: Grip
groups.limitations: Picture-only picks are accepted; physical grip flags are refused by the exporter and belong to spec_builder (HRG-GS-G1, #13346).

fallback_group.name: Other
fallback_group.sources: A flag no group rule matches yet; it is exposed but hidden by min_maturity beta until it is classified.

remote_exclusions.stride: Deprecated alias for time-based playback; use speeds and fps.

bundle_build.sources: Options the exporter cannot change because they are fixed when the bundle is built; listed so later surfaces can offer a rebuild.

roots.sources: Remote requests may read only below the input roots and write only below the output root; defaults are relative to the repository root and the environment variables override them (os.pathsep-separated for inputs).
